title: Westbrook School Committee — Special Meeting

fields.Location: Westbrook High School (Room 114), 125 Stroudwater St. (Hybrid via Zoom)

note: This summary highlights the meeting's key discussions and decisions, with direct quotes and timestamps for verification — it is not a substitute for watching the full meeting. Six of seven regular members were present (Brooke Reed absent; she did not answer at any of the three roll calls); no student representatives attended. This was a brief, single-item special meeting. For complete context, nuance, and anything not covered, watch the full video at the link above. (Produced by: WestbrookCurrents.com)
attendance: Present: Chair Andrea Mancuso, Vice Chair Katy Rice, Allison Brunette, Erin Cavallaro, Noreen Poitras, Dr. Flynn Ross. Absent: Brooke Reed.

blocks.x: Revised Fiscal Year 2027 (FY27) Budget: Second & Final Reading
6.1 — Adoption of the Revised FY27 Budget (Second and Final Reading, Roll Call Vote)

This short special meeting had a single item. It finalized the budget revision first approved April 29. The revision is a $136,295.39 reduction to Articles 3, 4, and 4A. It reflects the cost of the School Resource Officer program moving entirely into the City's public safety budget (see the April 29 summary for full background). There was no public comment and no committee discussion.

Approved 6–0 by roll call (second and final reading), unanimous. A final reading is the final, binding vote. Mover not stated on the recording. Seconded by Allison Brunette. This completes the School Committee's part of the FY27 budget process. The combined municipal/school budget goes to the City Council for its own second and final vote the same evening.

howMade: This summary was produced from the meeting video (linked above, hosted on the City's Vimeo showcase). The audio was transcribed with AI-assisted speech-to-text and speaker identification. This process cross-checked names against the official School Committee roster, attributed speakers from context (introductions, roll-call order, direct address by the Chair) rather than the raw diarization labels alone, and drafted this summary and the quoted excerpts. Quotes are lightly cleaned of filler words/false starts but not reworded. Reviewed by Gerald Doyon.
